finalText:
Suite is green: 625/625 passing, and `verify.js` confirms the fix is correct (not a spec/runner hack).

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` was charging tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, contradicting its own doc comment ("tax the amount the customer pays"). Only rows with both a nonzero discount and tax exposed it, which is why almost everything else looked fine. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`.
